prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Quick Adoption Grid: Redesign the friend selection step into a split layout presenting immediate preset pets alongside custom generation options. (why: Adoption step has the lowest step conversion at 60.9% and support reported custom pet creation failures.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Walkthrough: Introduce a dedicated controls visual guide screen right before completing onboarding to teach users how to summon and hide their pet. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and multiple support emails express confusion over pet desktop controls.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Story Screen First Onboarding Sequence: Reorder onboarding screens so story introduction appears before path choice to build attachment early. (why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users immediately; immersing users in pet lore first can improve initial engagement.)
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Mini Game While Waiting: Add an interactive pet reaction mini activity directly inside the render waiting screen while asset generation processes. (why: The waiting step has an extremely high mean waiting time of 2336 seconds causing user drop-off.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery & Sync Assurance Banner: Display a persistent safety hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in safely restores their adopted pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after re-signing into accounts.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting Callout: Provide rendering progress details and desktop display troubleshooting tips on the waiting screen. (why: Support received 3 tickets where pets failed to display on the desktop post-setup.)
6: [adoption, layout] Official Adoption Certificate Preview Stage: Switch adoption certificate layout to a stage view featuring an animated official adoption stamp and pet name confirmation. (why: Adoption drop-off is high (60.9% conversion), requiring a more rewarding completion moment.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Tray Summon Notification Tip: Enable desktop readiness notifications with quick tips on how to interact with the pet once rendered. (why: Users struggle with understanding how to hide or talk to pets after completing setup.)
